column1: # parser/spec/canon-fixpoint.tsv — ADR-015's fixpoint diagnostic, its shrink-only ledger.
# Both parser runners re-render every parse.tsv row that parses: canon of the
# parsed stream, parsed again, must canon to the same text (a violation of the
# fixpoint is always a violation of ADR-015's round-trip contract). A row that
# does not reach its fixpoint must be listed here, with the record that
# closes it; a listed row that now reaches it fails the runners until it is
# removed. The row count is pinned in both runners — the ledger only shrinks.
# Columns: parse.tsv source (escaped as there) <TAB> record <TAB> why.
# Landed 2026-09-26 with NUR072, whose own kinds (a plain word, the lambda
# fold, the mini literal, the type bound, the group modifiers) all reach
# their fixpoint; every row below is a kind that gate found.
